text.tspan: S1: M2x0.4-6H square to the flat, toward the rear, centre
3.00 above the rim. Mask it during anodise.
FIT, after anodise: D-bore 6.05 +0.03/0, flat 4.55 +0.03/0
across, to Z 6.90: slip fit on the encoder shaft.
FIT: round relief 6.05 +0.03/0, Z 1.20 to 2.20. Counterbore
Anodise grows the bore by about 0.01 to 0.02: mask the bore
or allow for it. Z is above the rim.
Outside 10.50, height 9.10, top edge R1.25 as modelled.
Cosmetic: outside and top face.
6061-T6 turned. Bead blast, Type II anodise, black,
appearance Strict; same batch and colour as the shells.
Two per set, both this part. The STEP is the left knob in
the assembly frame.
General tolerance ISO 2768-m (a proposal, not a tested
requirement). Break edges 0.05 unless drawn.
Not ordered. Nothing has been milled. Check every fit on the
first article before the batch.
